meta.name: controlled-waiting
meta.description: Executes timed waiting using 'wait' or 'wait1' actions to advance the simulation clock. Use when a time-dependent process like plant growth, chemical reaction, or mechanical cycle must progress before you can continue the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进模拟时钟等待时间依赖过程完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟环境中等待时间依赖过程完成
copy.tagline_en: Advance simulation clock to wait for time-dependent processes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to wait for time-dependent processes in a simulation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会使用'wait'或'wait1'动作来推进模拟时钟，使时间依赖的过程（如植物生长、化学反应等）继续，然后检查是否达到目标状态。如果未达到，则重复等待和检查。
howto.when: 当您启动了一个需要时间延迟的过程，且没有其他可操作动作时触发，例如等待植物生长或化学反应的完成。

say.text: 等待香蕉树结果后告诉我。
say.note: Claude会使用'wait'推进10步，然后检查。

say.text: 用wait1步进观察化学反应变化。
say.note: 每次推进1步，适合精细观察。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will use 'wait' or 'wait1' actions to advance the simulation clock, allowing time-dependent processes (e.g., plant growth, chemical reactions) to progress, then check if the target state is reached. If not, repeat waiting and checking.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have initiated a process with a time delay and no other productive actions are possible, e.g., waiting for plant growth or chemical reactions to complete.

say_en.text: Wait for the banana tree to bear fruit and tell me.
say_en.note: Claude will use 'wait' to advance 10 steps and check.

say_en.text: Use wait1 to step through and observe chemical reactions.
say_en.note: Advances 1 step each time, suitable for fine observation.
